headline: Gambhir 'Concerned' by India's Batting Collapses After 244-Run Rout in New Zealand
subheadline: India folded for 89 chasing 334 at Mount Maunganui, their second-heaviest ODI defeat. The head coach said the repeat collapses — not one bad innings — are the problem, in conditions he called the closest thing to next year's World Cup.

headline: Traditional Indian Diet and Daily Walks Put 61% of Early Diabetes Patients in Remission, Study Finds
subheadline: In a 87-person Maharashtra trial, a moderate-carbohydrate diet of everyday Indian foods plus a 40-minute daily walk produced an estimated 60.9% remission rate at six months — with walking consistency the strongest predictor. The researchers caution it was a single-arm study and no one should change medication without a doctor.

headline: Harmanpreet Kaur Unveils Wax Statue in Jaipur, Says 171 Knock Changed Women's Cricket
subheadline: The former India captain's figure will stand permanently beside Tendulkar and Dhoni at Nahargarh Fort. At the unveiling she credited her 171-run innings with changing perceptions, and told young women cricketers to bat like Vaibhav Sooryavanshi.

headline: Microsoft 365 Outage Rolls Into Second Day, Knocking Out Indian Airlines' Email Support
subheadline: Outlook and Exchange Online have been failing worldwide since Thursday evening. IndiGo and Akasa Air warned passengers their email support is down, Air India rerouted its mail, and Microsoft — reporting only 'marginal success' by Friday afternoon — has given no time for full recovery.

headline: Bihar Teen Who Could Not Afford IIT Coaching Wins Diana Award for Mentoring 25,000 Students
subheadline: Adarsh Kumar, now a student at Georgetown University in Qatar, founded the education platform Skillzo at 16 after his own path to coaching in Kota collapsed for want of money. He is one of 49 Indians on this year's Diana Award roll of honour.

headline: Kerala Seafarer Stranded in Iran Gets Emergency Certificate, Set to Return Home
subheadline: The MEA said Akshay Harish, disembarked at Chabahar Port after his passport and seafarer documents were reported lost, is now ready to travel back to Kerala, while India separately pressed Pakistan over six seafarers stranded at Karachi for six months.

headline: Mookuthi Amman 2: Critics Say Nayanthara's Star Power Can't Save This Overstuffed Sequel
subheadline: A mixed reception highlights the film's visual ambition but weak storytelling.

headline: Claude Login Outage Locked Users Out for Two Hours Friday
subheadline: Anthropic's status page logged an authentication incident at 09:58 UTC on November 13 affecting claude.ai, Claude Code, the Console and Cowork, resolved at 11:58 UTC, followed by a separate degraded-performance incident resolved at 15:38 UTC.

headline: WHO Classifies El Niño Health Impacts Emergency, Flags India High Risk
subheadline: WHO's September assessment lists high or very high risks for India from heat, dengue and leptospirosis, with malaria in parts of the northeast, as the WMO says El Niño is expected to reach record strength by December.

headline: US Immigration Curbs Could Cost Economy $668 Billion, Study Estimates
subheadline: An NFAP analysis estimates a 20% fall in international STEM graduate students could cost the U.S. $668 billion a year in patent-linked value, while research it reviews finds H-1B restrictions push firms to expand employment in India and other countries.

headline: Air India Extends Saudi Suspensions: Riyadh, Dammam to November 30
subheadline: Air India and Air India Express will keep Riyadh and Dammam flights suspended until November 30, 2026 and Jeddah until November 21, with free rescheduling or a full refund for eligible bookings issued on or before November 10.

headline: Sensex Diwali Rally Faces Test Beyond Festive Sentiment, Analysts Say
subheadline: A Mint analysis of Bloomberg data shows the Sensex's 8.78% pre-Muhurat surge was the biggest in three decades, but in 6 of 19 comparable years the gains did not last — and analysts say foreign cash buying, crude and Q2 earnings will decide this one.

headline: Man Dies After Biting Explosive Handed to Him as Rasgulla Sweet
subheadline: Police in Madhya Pradesh's Dindori district say a 35-year-old man died after a crude boar-hunting explosive, described to him as a rasgulla, detonated in his mouth, and two men have been held as officers probe whether it was killing or mischief.

headline: Delhi Air Turns Severe as Outdoor Workers Bear Brunt of Smog
subheadline: The capital recorded an AQI of 403 on Friday morning, and the workers who cannot stay indoors — traffic police, vendors, sweepers and delivery staff — face the longest exposure.

headline: Dhurandhar Opens Indian Panorama as IFFI Goa Unveils 2026 Programme
subheadline: The 57th International Film Festival of India runs in Goa from November 20 to 28, with Ramayana opening the BRICS segment and The Kerala Story 2: Goes Beyond in the International Competition.

headline: Stock Futures Edge Lower After Slide As Nvidia Turmoil Weighs On AI Trade
subheadline: Nasdaq futures led early declines on Friday after Nvidia fell 4.3% on Jensen Huang's exit, with oil above $95 and producer price data next.

headline: Sensex Ends 319 Points Lower, Nifty At 25,144 As Inflation Breaches RBI Limit
subheadline: Benchmarks snapped a three-day winning run on November 13 as October inflation at 6.09% and crude above $95 a barrel weighed on auto, realty and metal stocks.

headline: Google Unveils Gemini Intelligent Eyewear From $395, On Sale December 10
subheadline: The display-free Android XR glasses, made with Samsung, Warby Parker and Gentle Monster, pair Gemini voice help with a 12-megapixel camera - but only with Pixel, select Galaxy and newer iPhones at launch.

headline: China Holds Unannounced Pacific Drills That Taiwan Calls Silent Intimidation
subheadline: Taiwanese officials told Reuters more than 100 Chinese vessels took part in early-November drills around Taiwan and across the western Pacific. Beijing has called its carrier activity routine and did not respond to Reuters on the wider deployment.

headline: AI Blood Tests Could Cut Fatty Liver Screening Cost in India
subheadline: AIG Hospitals and ISB say routine blood work screened by AI costs Rs 200-Rs 300 per patient, against Rs 5,000-Rs 6,000 for scans - as a first step, not a diagnosis.

headline: Bihar Man Arrested After Wife's Killing in Munger, Police Say He Surrendered
subheadline: Police in Jamalpur say the 55-year-old retired loco pilot surrendered with the couple's two daughters after his 28-year-old wife was found dead at their rented home. The motive remains under investigation.

headline: BrahMos Exports Widen in Southeast Asia as Philippines Seeks More Systems
subheadline: The Philippines has taken delivery and Vietnam has signed, while talks with other Southeast Asian nations are at an advanced stage and still await government clearance, reporting says.

headline: Producer Jayanta Mukherjee, Husband of Moushumi Chatterjee, Dies in Mumbai
subheadline: The son of singer-composer Hemant Kumar died on 12 November at his Khar residence in his late 70s, FWICE confirmed, after more than five decades of marriage.

headline: India Cancels Norwegian Journalist's Visa Hours Before Hyderabad Summit Trip
subheadline: Helle Lyng Svendsen of Dagsavisen says her visa was cancelled minutes before departure for a press-freedom panel. The Editors Guild and CPJ have sought an explanation; the government had not publicly given one as of November 13.

headline: Indian Climbers Make First Recorded Indian Ascent of Tharang II Peak
subheadline: Subhajit Banerjee and Suresh Singh summited the 6,027-metre Miyar Valley peak on 22 September via a new West Ridge line named Moonlight Spur.

headline: Gunjan Beats Bensalah 5-0 to Win Historic Youth Olympics Boxing Gold
subheadline: The Haryana boxer won the women's 48kg final in Dakar 5-0, becoming the first Indian female boxer to win Youth Olympics gold.

headline: Iran Claims Strike on U.S. Radar in Bahrain; No U.S. Confirmation Yet
subheadline: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said they targeted a U.S. early-warning radar in Bahrain in retaliation for a strike in Sirik. Washington and Manama had not commented, and the claim is unverified.

headline: Suriya Becomes First Tamil Actor With Three 200 Crore Grossers in One Year
subheadline: Koimoi reported Karuppu, Vishwanath And Sons and Scene all crossed Rs 200 crore worldwide in 2026, with producer and tracker figures differing on Scene's exact total.

headline: India-EU Free Trade Agreement Will Be Game Changer, Says German Envoy
subheadline: Ambassador Jasper Wieck said the pact, expected to be signed by year-end and take effect in the first half of next year, will cut tariffs and integrate supply chains.

headline: Modi Inaugurates Bengaluru Metro Pink Line Stretch, Public Rides From November 14
subheadline: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar flagged off the 7.5-km Kalena Agrahara to S.G. Palya section, taking Bengaluru's metro network past 100 km.

headline: Canada Details 100,000 Extra Permanent Residence Spaces for 2027 Applicants
subheadline: IRCC has published the pathway-by-pathway breakdown for 2027, covering Hong Kong, Ukraine, family sponsorship and humanitarian applicants already in Canada who have already applied.

headline: Bank of Baroda Hikes 555-Day FD Rate to 6.85 Percent: What Rs 1 Lakh Earns
subheadline: The bob Golden Goal 555-day deposit now pays 6.85% to general customers and up to 7.50% to super senior citizens, effective November 12 — the only tenor the bank changed.

headline: Gujarat Father Arrested After Daughter, 21, Killed Over Inter-Caste Relationship
subheadline: Police in Anand district allege the father strangled his daughter with her dupatta on Diwali night and the death was presented as natural until a postmortem found ligature strangulation.

headline: Andhra to Enact Investment Protection Act So Deals Survive Regime Change
subheadline: Naidu told the CII summit that land, incentives and approvals granted to investors will be legally protected from reversal by future governments, with a Bill planned for the December winter session.

headline: Andhra Earmarks 5,000 Acres Near Tirupati for Space Sector Push
subheadline: At the CII Partnership Summit's close, Naidu named the Tirupati land bank as rocket startups Agnikul Cosmos and Hathor Rockets signed MoUs worth a proposed Rs 760 crore combined.

headline: Anita Somani Wins Third Ohio House Term With 70.79 Percent of Vote
subheadline: The Indian American obstetrician-gynecologist defeated Republican Kelly Hunter-Kalagidis by 20,738 votes in District 8, her strongest showing in three elections.

headline: US Revokes More Than 6,000 Visas Linked to Birth Tourism
subheadline: The State Department's Birth Tourism Prevention Task Force passed 6,000 revocations, up from 4,000 at the end of October — targeting travellers and the commercial networks that arranged their trips.

headline: New Zealand Thrash India by 244 Runs to Keep ODI Series Alive
subheadline: Will Young's 125 punished two early drops as New Zealand posted 333 at Bay Oval, before Matt Henry's opening-over burst bowled India out for 89.

headline: Jaipur Monuments Draw Bigger Crowds as Post-Diwali Tourist Surge Builds
subheadline: Amer Fort jumped from 8,186 to 10,923 visitors in a day as Diwali trips extended and winter arrivals began. With the Pushkar Fair opening November 19, Rajasthan's peak season is already under way.

headline: Bollywood Bolsters Security as Shootings Revive Underworld Fears
subheadline: After gunfire at Tiger Shroff's car and a wave of extortion threats linked to the Bishnoi gang, stars are hiring bodyguards, police are telling actors to avoid crowds, and the industry is arguing over whether the 1990s are really back.

headline: Amul Raises Milk Prices by Up to Rs 4 a Litre, Second Hike in Six Months
subheadline: GCMMF cites fodder, feed, packaging and fuel costs plus uneven rainfall for the November 12 increase. Taaza rises ₹2 a litre, Gold ₹4, and Mother Dairy has moved in step.

headline: Google Launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Its Fast Model for Agentic Work
subheadline: Hydrogen takes the execution tier of the Gemini 4 family: faster than the old Flash line, priced at $1.50/$7.50 per million tokens, and now running inside Google Search for all users.

headline: USCIS May Stop Deferring to Prior Approvals Under Visa Extension Proposal
subheadline: DHS proposes deleting the rule that tells officers to follow an earlier I-129 approval on extensions for the same worker and job. Comments close November 13; the current rule stays in force until a final rule is published.

headline: New Zealand Thrash India 5-0 in Auckland in First Friendly
subheadline: An early Bijoy Varghese own goal, a Jesse Randall brace, and second-half goals from Chris Wood and Lachlan Bayliss gave New Zealand a 5-0 win in the opening match of India's New Zealand tour; the sides meet again in Christchurch on Sunday.

headline: ISRO Test-Fires Revised PSLV Third Stage After Two Flight Anomalies
subheadline: The strengthened PS3 solid motor was successfully ground-tested at Sriharikota on November 12 after anomalies on PSLV-C61 and PSLV-C62; ISRO says further tests will follow a detailed review of the data, and has not declared the vehicle ready to fly.

headline: Inside the Delhi Home Holding Indoor AQI at 10-15 With 15,000 Plants
subheadline: As Delhi's air stayed in the very poor range under GRAP Stage III, Peter Singh and Neeno Kaur's Sainik Farms home — built around 15,000 plants, filtered air and aquaponics — is drawing attention again for indoor readings of 10-15.

headline: Farm Growth Topped 4% for a Decade, Modi Tells Kisan Tak Conference
subheadline: Addressing the Kisan Tak Bharat Agriculture Conference in New Delhi, the Prime Minister credited a decade of above-4% farm growth with helping 50 crore people defeat poverty, and urged crop diversification and natural farming.

headline: Mercor's Indian-Origin Founders Double Wealth to $4.2 Billion Each at 23
subheadline: A $750 million funding round valuing AI hiring startup Mercor at $20 billion has lifted Forbes' estimates for co-founders Adarsh Hiremath and Surya Midha, and CEO Brendan Foody, to about $4.2 billion each.

headline: NPPA Orders Strict Checks So Cancer Drug Price Cuts Reach Patients
subheadline: With revised prices for 137 anti-cancer drugs in force since November 9, the drug pricing authority has ordered strict enforcement checks; states including Andhra Pradesh have directed inspections of cancer hospitals and pharmacies.

headline: Visa Uncertainty Is Making US Tech Workers Put Life Plans on Hold
subheadline: Tech workers on H-1B and student visas told Business Insider they are delaying purchases, weighing moves to Canada or the UK, and bracing for fewer sponsoring employers after IBM's sponsorship pullback and the PERM suspensions.

headline: 19 Indian Seafarers Safe After Tanker Struck Off UAE Coast
subheadline: All 22 crew of the Liberia-flagged MT Dominica Prosperity were evacuated by the UAE Coast Guard after a projectile hit the tanker's engine room off Mina Saqr on November 11, India's shipping minister said.

headline: Special Electoral Roll Camps Set for November 21, 22 and 29 in Tamil Nadu
subheadline: Special camps for electoral roll revision will be held at designated locations in Tamil Nadu on Saturday, November 21, Sunday, November 22 and Sunday, November 29, 2026. Voters can get forms and guidance for additions, deletions and corrections ahead of the December 11, 2026 deadline.

headline: Azam Khan Gets Four Days in ED Custody, Faces Lucknow Questioning Friday
subheadline: A Ghaziabad special court gave the ED four days' custody of Samajwadi Party leader Mohammad Azam Khan, until November 16, 2026, in the money-laundering investigation linked to Jauhar University. Khan is to be brought to Lucknow for questioning.

headline: Kunal Kemmu's Hindi Comedy Vibe Arrives on Prime Video November 13
subheadline: Kunal Kemmu's Hindi action-comedy Vibe, co-starring Preity G Zinta and Sparsh Shrivastava, premieres on Prime Video on November 13, 2026 after a September theatrical run. It is Kemmu's second film as director, after Madgaon Express.

headline: Draft Electoral Rolls Released in Cuddalore, Villupuram and Kallakurichi for Checking
subheadline: Tamil Nadu's integrated draft electoral roll is out, with district lists published for Cuddalore, Villupuram and Kallakurichi. Voters have until December 11, 2026 to verify their details and seek additions, deletions or corrections before the final roll on January 4, 2027.

headline: Kareena Kapoor Khan Gets Legal Notice Over Quranic Verse Pendant Worn for Diwali
subheadline: Reports say Abbas Hafeez sent a legal notice to Kareena Kapoor Khan and stylist Rhea Kapoor asking for Diwali photographs showing an emerald pendant inscribed with Ayat-ul-Kursi to be removed and for an apology — a demand, not a court finding.

headline: Chinese AI Firms Rush to Reserve Overseas Nvidia Capacity Amid Curbs Fear
subheadline: Reuters, citing three people familiar with the matter, reported Chinese AI companies are trying to rent Nvidia-powered capacity overseas over fears Washington will regulate remote access to restricted processors.

headline: Vodafone Idea Q2 Loss Widens After One-Off Charge, ARPU Rises
subheadline: For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, Vodafone Idea's reported net loss widened to Rs 5,975 crore after a Rs 462 crore exceptional charge, even as its pre-exceptional loss narrowed and ARPU rose to Rs 198.

headline: Ro Khanna Holds More Campaign Cash Than Seven Lawmakers Combined
subheadline: FEC records as reported show the California Democrat with about $16.6 million and no debt, against roughly $11.1 million combined for the other seven Indian-American House members and members-elect.

headline: India TB Mortality Falls 38 Percent Since 2015, WHO Report Finds
subheadline: The WHO Global Tuberculosis Report 2026, as summarised in a government release, puts India's TB death rate at 18 per lakh in 2025, down from 28 per lakh in 2015, with a 94% treatment success rate.

headline: Gauhati High Court Says PAN, Voter ID Alone Cannot Prove Citizenship
subheadline: In Kulchan Begum's case, the court held that PAN cards and EPICs issued on self-application are not proof of citizenship unless the records behind them are proved, and upheld a Foreigners Tribunal opinion.

headline: Brazil's WEG Picks Dharmapuri for Rs 2,000 Crore Manufacturing Facility
subheadline: The Brazilian electrical equipment maker confirmed Tamil Nadu after a five-month negotiation, with a proposed Rs 2,000-crore investment and potential for around 3,000 jobs, the Industries Department said.

headline: Indian Nationals Among 14 Killed in Fujairah Multi-Vehicle Crash and Fire
subheadline: A truck lost control shortly before midnight on Sheikh Khalifa bin Zayed Road, overturned and caught fire in a 23-vehicle pile-up; India's consulate in Dubai says it has reached out to bereaved families.

headline: Shreyas Iyer Makes ODI Captaincy Debut as India Eye Series Seal
subheadline: Iyer leads India for the first time in the fourth ODI at Bay Oval on Friday, November 13, with the visitors 2-0 up after the Hamilton washout and one win away from sealing the series.

headline: Sonam Wangchuk Claims House Arrest as Ladakh Protests Winter Poll Schedule
subheadline: The climate activist says dozens of armed guards surround his Leh residence after demands to postpone the December 4 hill council elections, while police say he was advised to stay home under prohibitory orders.

headline: Affordability Will Decide AI Winners in India, Peak XV's Anandan Says
subheadline: In NDTV's Walk The Talk, Rajan Anandan argues homegrown companies building smaller, cost-effective models for real-world use can win at home and compete globally, even as AI reshapes outsourcing and software jobs.

headline: Masala Mixtape Brings 18 South Asian Artists to The Matriarch in NYC
subheadline: The South Asian music festival returned for its fifth year on October 23, 2026, with hip-hop, pop, R&B, electronic and Bollywood acts, 10-plus vendors and tiered tickets from $20 to $80.

headline: Democrats Vow to Rein In Trump's Immigration Crackdown After Midterm Backlash
subheadline: Fresh from winning both chambers, Democrats plan ICE oversight, standards legislation and a push on legal pathways, but Trump's veto and Stephen Miller's move to chief of staff limit what they can enact.

headline: Indians Top OECD Citizenship List Again: 9.25 Lakh in Five Years
subheadline: Indian citizens acquired more OECD citizenships than any other nationality between 2020 and 2024, with Canada, the US and Australia leading, the OECD's International Migration Outlook 2026 shows.

headline: Puerto Rico Governor Hosts First Diwali at Palace, Eyes India Trade Mission
subheadline: Jenniffer González-Colón hosted a Diwali celebration at Santa Catalina Palace on November 10 and, in an exclusive interview, linked India ties to pharma, aerospace and a possible trade mission next year.

headline: Woman Loses Arm After Alleged Molestation and Push at Naigaon Station; Suspect Arrested
subheadline: A 20-year-old on a Borivali-to-Virar local was allegedly pushed at Naigaon on November 4, fell between coaches and lost her left arm; police arrested a 53-year-old man after a CCTV review.

headline: Raichandani's 93 Powers India U19 Past Afghanistan Into Asia Cup Final
subheadline: India chased 228 with 79 balls to spare at Al Amerat, winning by eight wickets after Ishan Sood's 3-43 sparked an Afghan collapse — Pakistan await in Saturday's final.

headline: Six Researchers Win Infosys Prize 2026, Including Legal Scholar Gautam Bhatia
subheadline: Karthik Sastry, Swarun Kumar, Gautam Bhatia, Isha Jain, Riddhipratim Basu and Manoj Kumar Joshi each receive a gold medal, citation and $100,000.

headline: NPCI's MDR-Funded Scheme Pays Banks to Put UPI QR Codes in Small-Town Shops
subheadline: The UPI Vyapaar Saksham Scheme recycles 5% of future MDR collections into Rs 300-per-QR and Rs 750-per-soundbox incentives for banks onboarding small merchants in Tier III-VI cities, the Northeast, J&K and Ladakh.

headline: IIT Madras Pravartak Opens Free Online Training for Students in Classes 7-12 and Teachers
subheadline: Free live online cohorts from November 2026 to January 2027 cover AI, electric vehicles and entrepreneurship for students, and career counselling, leadership and classroom management for teachers.

headline: Inside Raga: Gaggan Anand's 22-Course Delhi Homecoming With Rydo Anton
subheadline: Anand's first restaurant in India pairs him with his Bangkok head chef of a decade and Zorawar Kalra: one tasting menu, 42 seats at 21A Janpath, and a booking queue that crashed the website on day one.

headline: Kerala Steps In to Bring Home Seafarer Stranded in Iran After Pakistan Seizes Crew's Documents
subheadline: Kollam native Akshay Harish has spent nearly a month confined in Chabahar after his ship's documents were confiscated in Pakistan and lost; the Indian Embassy in Iran is expected to issue him temporary travel papers.

headline: More Than Half of India's Fertiliser Never Feeds the Crop, Scientists Tell Kisan Tak Conference
subheadline: Crops absorb only 30-45% of applied nitrogen and as little as 15% of phosphorus, experts told the Delhi agriculture conference — and the remedy they prescribed was balanced nutrition and root-placed urea, not more bags.

headline: Bollywood Romance 'Weekend' Eyes First Indian Feature Shoot in Russia's Yakutia
subheadline: Producer Vivek Singhania's Picture Perfect has signed a three-way MoU with Saidam Baryl and Sakhafilm, Yakutia's state-backed studio, to explore shooting the romantic drama in the Sakha Republic — a first for an Indian feature.

headline: Chicago's Field Museum Hosts Diwali Celebration With Dance, Diyas and Ayurveda on November 15
subheadline: The museum's Cultural Programming series marks the festival of lights on Sunday, November 15, from 12:30 to 5 p.m., with classical dance, Bollywood performances, henna, diya decorating, and two science sessions — all included with admission.

headline: BBC Verify: Delhi's Official Diwali Averages Missed Every Reading Above 1,000 Micrograms
subheadline: Comparing CPCB figures with DPCC station data, BBC Verify found 217 missing hourly observations in the Diwali peak window and station averages less than half the DPCC's — while the CPCB blames older analysers capped at 1,000 micrograms.

headline: Companies Led by Indian-Origin Chiefs Now Worth $15 Trillion, Up 53%, Hurun Finds
subheadline: The second HSBC Hurun Global Indians List counts 236 Indian-origin CEOs, chairpersons, and founders across 200 companies headquartered outside India, with more than 70% of the value in AI-driven firms.

headline: Congressman-Elect Amish Shah Puts Tariffs and Anti-Indian Hate at Top of His Agenda
subheadline: The Arizona Democrat, the first South Asian American elected to Congress from the state, says Indian-American entrepreneurs are being hurt by tariffs and that reclaiming Congress's tariff authority from the White House will be a top priority from January 3.

headline: Foreign Divorce Cannot End a Marriage Solemnised in India, Supreme Court Rules
subheadline: In the N. Sridhar Reddy case, the court held that a UK decree based on irretrievable breakdown fails Section 13 CPC, so the husband's bigamy trial continues — while proceedings against his parents and second wife were quashed.

headline: India's Retail Inflation Breaches RBI Ceiling at 6.09% as Food Prices Surge
subheadline: October's CPI reading, the highest since October 2024, crossed the RBI's 6% upper tolerance limit as food inflation hit 8.94% and onion prices more than doubled, strengthening expectations of a second straight rate hike in December.

headline: Modi Heads to Manila for ASEAN and East Asia Summits From November 16 to 18
subheadline: The Prime Minister will attend the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit and the 21st East Asia Summit in the Philippine capital, with bilateral meetings and an Indian community interaction also planned.

headline: Desi Twist Brings Upscale Mughlai Cooking to Hoover, Alabama
subheadline: Chef Sanjay Verma's new family-owned restaurant pairs tandoori classics and a halal-certified kitchen with brunch twists like chicken tikka Benedict at Brocks Gap Parkway.

headline: Arshdeep Singh and Actor Samreen Kaur Announce Engagement in New Zealand
subheadline: Kaur shared the proposal photographs on Instagram on November 11 — the same day Arshdeep's Rs 18 crore move to Mumbai Indians headlined the IPL trade window.

headline: Post-Diwali Reset Without Crash Diets: Experts Advise Habits Over Detox
subheadline: Doctors and dietitians quoted this week converge on the same prescription — regular meals, probiotic staples, post-meal walks and sleep — and against the detox products marketed every festival season.

headline: Overspent This Diwali? A Sober Plan to Clear Festive Card Debt
subheadline: Card debt at over 40% a year is the most expensive money in the house. Here is the order to tackle it: total it, pay above the minimum, then move what remains to cheaper money.

headline: Tequila in India Moves From Shots to Slow, Premium Sipping
subheadline: Category sales nearly doubled in a year, agave bars are stocking 30-plus labels, and Indian investors — including a Shah Rukh Khan-backed brand — are buying into premium tequila.

headline: Teen Chess Master Md Imran Risks US Scholarship as Visa Deadline Closes In
subheadline: The 17-year-old International Master's approved F-1 visa was in the passport he lost in Bratislava. Four months without a US appointment, he must be stamped by January 19, 2027 — or lose his full UTRGV scholarship.

headline: Kejriwal, Daughter Threatened in Call Demanding Rs 7 Crore in Bishnoi Gang's Name
subheadline: The threat reached AAP MLA Jarnail Singh, who complained to Mohali Police on November 6. A case is registered, but the caller's claimed gang link is unverified.

headline: Adobe and Google Deepen Pact: Gemini Reaches Photoshop, Acrobat Comes to Gmail
subheadline: Announced at Adobe MAX on November 10, the expanded partnership puts PDF editing inside Gmail and Drive and Google's AI models inside Adobe's creative apps — though key pieces have no launch date yet.

headline: Sunita Williams Leads New York Veterans Day Parade as Grand Marshal
subheadline: The retired NASA astronaut and Navy captain, who spent 608 days in space across three missions, headed the 107th annual parade up Fifth Avenue on November 11.

headline: TCS Becomes Official AI and Technology Partner of the Rio Marathon
subheadline: The partnership, announced November 11, is TCS's first marathon sponsorship in Latin America and adds Latin America's largest street race to its 14-event global running portfolio.

headline: Bajaj Finance Launches Rs 11,700 Crore QIP at Rs 992.25 Floor Price
subheadline: The institutional share sale is half of a Rs 17,500 crore capital plan, alongside Rs 5,800 crore of warrants allotted to promoter Bajaj Finserv at Rs 1,010 each.

headline: H-1B Wage Rule Reaches White House as Final Rule; Higher Floors Could Land in 2027
subheadline: OIRA received the Labor Department's prevailing-wage final rule on November 6. As proposed, entry-level H-1B wages would rise from the 17th to the 34th percentile.

headline: Ramayana Crosses Rs 900 Crore Worldwide in First Week as Day 7 Beats Opening Day
subheadline: Sacnilk estimates put Day 7 India net at Rs 70.65 crore — above the opening day — with India net past Rs 500 crore and overseas gross at about Rs 323.50 crore.

headline: Nvidia Slides 8% on Report Board May Oust Huang; Sensex Ends 117 Points Lower
subheadline: The after-hours fall followed a Journal report on CEO Jensen Huang; Nvidia's board said on November 8 it had no reason to believe company secrets were compromised.
